title: pptx_generic
description: Contract of the generic advisory PPTX template (`pptx-generic`, 16:9 house style), rendered by functions/delivery/renderers/pptx-generic/render.py. For advisory decks no registered report template governs; the CISO decks (ciso-reporting-deck, ciso-global-deck, tprm-board-slide) have their own contracts and must not use this one.

bullets.description: Keep to 8 lines: the layout has no overflow handling.

notes.description: Speaker notes; carried into the deck, not rendered on the slide.

sources.description: Rendered as a closing Sources slide.
